# translation_id: # THE TRANSITION MAPS OF THE ATLAS.
# A pile of representations is not one object until there are maps between the
# overlaps. Lean, shell, git, prose and transcripts are separate charts; this
# file is what makes them charts OF something rather than five documents about
# the same thing.
# WHY IT EXISTS: a reader filed a defect against correct figures because the
# continued-fraction sweep reports a period on RP-1 and the root-argument
# convention reports one on R-2. Same object, two languages, factor of two. No
# record of the mapping existed, so a retraction was written, then amended, and
# a third party had to reconstruct the convention from a line number in a file
# that had been unreachable an hour earlier. That was not an error. It was an
# untracked transition map.
# THE PROPERTY THAT MAKES THIS WORTH HAVING: a translation failure is detectable
# WITHOUT KNOWING WHICH SIDE IS RIGHT. You do not need a kernel, an adjudicator,
# or an authority. You need the round trip to be the identity. Every other gate
# in this repository resolves to "run it and see"; this one resolves to "close
# the loop and see", and needs no privileged party at all.
# method is one of, and there is no third:
#   roundtrip  spec is  forward|back|probe  -- awk expressions in x, and a probe
#              value. bin/atlas.sh RUNS them: back(forward(probe)) must equal
#              probe. A claimed translation that does not close is refused.
#   witness    spec is a path, relative to the repo root, that MUST EXIST. This
#              is the weaker form and it is counted separately, so the atlas
#              reports its own honesty ratio rather than averaging it away.
# '-' in method or spec is refused. Same discipline as mechanism and control:
# two legal answers, and "nobody looked" is not one of them.
# GENUS. bin/atlas.sh reads source and target as nodes and each row as an edge,
# then counts connected components. Each component is a set of languages that
# can reach each other; content in one island cannot leave it. Holes =
# components + 1, where the +1 is the center that no translation removes. The
# number is DERIVED and it MOVES: add a translation joining two islands and it
# drops. The shape of the surface is a fact about this file.
